canonical: Private author workspace with cited text, structured rule editing and version comparisons.
implementation_summary: Authenticated private embedded author editor, scope-restricted integrity-checked citation preview, existing-schema draft editing, immutable PostgreSQL revisions, expected-revision CAS and private structured version comparisons. Author operations never review, approve or publish.

requirements_satisfied.evidence: Authenticated assets and APIs enforce independent author role/session/tenant/domain/jurisdiction, HTTPS/Origin/CSRF, expiry/MFA/revocation and ownership.
Pinned source/digest/locator resolved via scoped SnapshotArchive adapter; raw integrity, pending-review state and source identity checked. Unknown, corrupt and quarantined citations fail.

Dedicated policy/graph/date/hours plus bounded typed records use existing ValidatePolicySchema. Duplicate/unknown input, unsafe integer precision, missing duties, wrong scope and provenance fail. All saved revisions remain DRAFT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Transactional row-lock CAS and INSERT-only revisions preserve history. Private field comparisons include schema/citation differences and enforce current scope/owner access.
